recap.text: Mordecai squeaks that he has chased the Charm Animal recipe for fifty cycles, and Donut collects a liter of Mongo's blood herself, spilling most of it. She drinks the green potion near Kiwi, who glows, and every raptor in the pack turns white with her. Carl plans a second batch from a liter of cat blood, and Sir Ferdinand, tail wagging in his ridiculous hat, joins the party as Donut's minion.

beats.headline: Fifty cycles of chasing
beats.text: Carl's silver box from the Apothecary holds two pieces of paper: a potion recipe and a drawing of Mongo. Mordecai squeaks. He has been chasing this one for fifty cycles. You don't chill it, you put it in the centrifuge and then flash-freeze it. So simple. He has the ingredients, too: the thorn sap tips Carl has collected by the dozen, and the hard one. They both turn to look at Mongo. The recipe is for Charm Animal, which has to be brewed for a specific animal. Absolutely not, says Donut. It's just blood, Carl says: a liter of it, collected outside a saferoom. Per potion, Mordecai adds.
beats.gist: Carl's recipe for Charm Animal needs Mongo's blood, a liter per potion, taken outside a saferoom.

beats.headline: A liter in the rain
beats.text: With the knockout potion in him, Mongo is asleep in a dryad town, and Donut has to collect the blood herself. Most of it goes all over the place, but a few wet monkeys help her hold the flask, which is really hard without thumbs, and there is no time for another liter. Mordecai only has time to make one charm potion. In the next town, Prepotente Number Seven, Carl rushes into the saferoom, grabs the finished green potion, and they bounce.
beats.gist: Wet monkeys help Donut collect Mongo's blood, and Carl grabs the finished green potion.

beats.headline: Donut glows, then Kiwi
beats.text: The raptors have the party surrounded in a clearing, and Mongo stays in his carrier in case his presence negates the spell. Donut needs to be close: the potion lasts a minute, and she must not charm the wrong one. It is named Charm Mongoliensis now, and it tames the closest eligible monster as Donut's minion for the duration of the floor. She walks to within ten feet of the pink dinosaur, telling Kiwi she is forgiven but not forgotten. Donut glows, and about three seconds after her, Kiwi glows. Her dot turns white with the green mark of a minion, and every raptor in the pack turns white with her.
beats.gist: Donut charms Kiwi with Charm Mongoliensis, and every raptor in the pack turns white with her.

beats.headline: A liter of cat blood
beats.text: Carl's planning notes, added to the cookbook: there is a difference between Donut enchanting someone, as she does the Bopcas, and magically charming them, as she did Kiwi. Enchanted, Ferdinand would fall over himself to please her but could still object. Charmed, he would be her official minion and do what she says almost without question. Mordecai can make a charm animal potion. All they need is a liter of cat blood, and they have a ready source. The spell is line of sight, so if Ferdinand is in the audience, Donut can down it the moment she goes on stage.
beats.gist: Carl plans to have Mordecai brew a charm potion from cat blood so Donut can charm Ferdinand.

beats.headline: Sir Ferdinand joins up
beats.text: Up on stage, the curtains pull back on Donut alone. Ferdinand sits on the center table among the three judges in his ridiculous hat, eyes on her, tail wagging. Carl hands a Feather Fall potion to a crawler as Donut's message comes in: she took the charm potion, and it worked. Come on, baby, Ferdinand calls, and tells Empress D'nadia that is his bird up there. Carl's interface blinks. Sir Ferdinand, minion of Princess Donut, has joined the party.
beats.gist: Donut's charm potion works on Ferdinand, and he joins Carl's party as her minion.
